claims.statement: For every N>=2, even m>=0, b>=1, uniformly nearly sample ordered identity transposition words with TV <= 2^(-b), expected bit time one polynomial in N,m,b; rightmost-first composition, independent fair bits.
claims.note: Mission target, not accepted. Existing restricted results keep their source-scoped statuses in the catalogue.

claims.statement: Exact fair-bit expected-polynomial sampler for connected fixed-endpoint transposition words of genus 0,1,2 on every fixed label set. Claimed bound O(v^11 log^3(v+1)).
claims.note: Exact scoped internal acceptance after fresh blind and current-version nonauthor reviews. Same-model reviews correlated; global mission OPEN.
